boundaryRule: Only visitor places inside Balcurvie's strict study area count toward the settlement score. Related attractions and cross-boundary routes may appear in See or Trails only when explicitly marked related_context and do not inflate the town.
scoreRationale: Balcurvie has one genuine bookable attraction—Claireville Alpacas—but the hamlet otherwise lacks a café, maintained place trail and public facilities. The attraction appears in See while Balcurvie itself stays below 60.
